report: Revision Kohn-Sham Rust solver: checks of the canonical matrix (SPEC section 7)

checks.name: theory_input_coefficients
checks.detail: ks-theory.json (sha256 1bf41d79318a24a4): M_eff = m + 0.9375 lambda S, v_v = -0.0625 lambda n, e_x = (-0.03125 n^2 + -0.03125 S^2) lambda; consistent: M_eff - m = d e_int/dS with e_int = (1/2 + -0.03125) lambda S^2 + -0.03125 lambda n^2, v_v = d e_int/dn

checks.name: gamma_fixture_numeric
checks.detail: gammas.json (sha256 95d8cbdd0682fd30): {gamma^a, gamma^b} = 2 eta^ab exactly in floating point (max deviation 0e0), C = g8 g1 g2 g3 and B = -i C g4 reproduced (max deviation 0e0)

checks.name: block_reduction_numeric
checks.detail: basis V of ks-theory.json (rows = spinor components): |V^dag V - 1| = 1.1e-16; off-block entries of V^dag X V 2.8e-17; diagonal blocks equal the solver's forms (i g4 g8 -> -i j sigma1, -i g4 -> j sigma2, -g4 g1 -> j sigma3, B B -> 1, B C -> j sigma2, B B g8 -> sigma3, -i B C g1 -> j sigma3, g8 -> sigma3, B -> j s2) to 1.1e-16: the 2x2 equation h_j = j[-i sigma1 d_y + M sigma2 + kappa k sigma3] + v integrated by the solver is the 16-component Hamiltonian

checks.name: free_k0_analytic_spectra
checks.detail: k = 0, constant M, v = 0, theta_tip = 0 (ks-theory.json boundaryConditions.exactK0Spectra) for (m, L) = (1, 3), (1, 2), (2, 3), labels -3..5 of both parities: even eps = 0 and +-sqrt(M^2 + (n pi/L)^2), odd eps = +-sqrt(M^2 + p^2) with tan(pL) = -p/M; max |difference| 7.23e-10 for |eps| < 4 m (tolerance 5e-9, RK4 error ~ (h eps)^4), 5.05e-8 for 4 m <= |eps| < 7 m (tolerance 3e-7)

checks.name: free_zero_mode_exact
checks.detail: k = 0 brane zero mode (both j): eps = 0 exactly, chi = (a, 0) with b = 0 identically (max |b| = 0e0); a = sqrt(2M/(1 - e^(-2ML))) e^(My) to 1.35e-12 (normalised, Simpson)

checks.name: free_brane_band_slope
checks.detail: d eps/dk at k = 0 of the even j = +1 brane band (Richardson extrapolation of eps(k)/k from k = 1e-4, 2e-4) equals ks-theory.json c = 1.9051482536448665 times e^(-a4,0) at a4,0 = [0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0] (M = H = 1, L = 3) to 1.87e-12 relative

checks.name: free_block_type_symmetries
checks.detail: lambda = 0, n2 in {0,1,2,5,9}, labels -3..3: spec h_(-1) = -spec h_(+1) (label l <-> -l even, -l-1 odd) to 0.0e0; sigma3 h_j(k) sigma3 = h_(-j)(-k): eps_(-1)(-k) = eps_(+1)(k) label by label to 0.0e0

checks.name: free_particle_branch_labels
checks.detail: for every shell n2 <= 30 and sector (j, parity): the lowest particle label l_min (first target above Phi(eps = 0)) has eps > 0 and l_min - 1 has eps < 0 (the branch split by the sign of the lambda = 0 level is a split of the Pruefer labels; closest level to zero away from the k = 0 zero modes: 0.4307 m); k = 0 even l_min = 0 is the zero mode (convention)

checks.name: free_tip_angle_insensitivity
